cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Withdraw the Objection
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Drop the demand to question our delivery driver. The missing-parcel claim goes through this form.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your form requires a photo of the parcel I haven't received.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Use a photo of your empty doorstep. That's the delivery location.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you stand in it holding today's newspaper?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, beside the doormat. Put me under 'supporting evidence,' and leave the driver off your witness list.

mechanism: A supervises the claimant's evidence to get them to abandon a driver interrogation and use the official missing-parcel form.
confusable: D176 requests an exception; D180 accommodates practical objections to keep B inside the existing process.
comparison: Evidence collaboration for a missing parcel differs from a donor asking for privileged queuing.
seedUse: Keep empty doorstep and dated photo offer; correct the actual form interpretation rather than merely announce professionalism.
